gaps: Manufacturer-sourced year: 2016 only, and that via Toyota's launch release PDF mirrored on tfltruck.com (pressroom.toyota.com copies failed). 2017-2026 are secondary (cars.com 2017-2021 and 2023; iSeeCars 2022; cars.com+Motor1 2024; KBB 2025; Carscoops 2026). Toyota's own text confirmed only the 2025 start price ($31,590) and the 2024 TRD Sport i-FORCE MAX ($46,300).

Toyota USA Newsroom: 2016, 2018, 2020 ('Leader of the Pack'), 2024 and 2026 pricing releases and the 2017 TRD Pro pricing release returned client errors; the 2021 release loaded but its pricing table is an image; 2019 (SX/TRD Pro) and 2020 (Chicago show, PDF 10195) releases carry no prices; PDF export 22006 (claimed 2016 Tacoma) served the 2026 GR Corolla release.

Destination recorded only where a fetched source stated it: 2016 $900 (Toyota), 2022 $1,335 (iSeeCars column), 2024 $1,495 (Motor1), 2025 $1,495 (KBB), 2026 $1,595 (Carscoops). 2017-2021 and 2023 null.

2018: TRD Sport missing (cars.com page truncated before it). 2021: Trail Special Edition and Nightshade not listed. 2022: Trail Edition / Nightshade not listed. 2023: TRD Sport and TRD Off-Road cheapest-row drivetrains flagged uncertain by the cars.com extraction. 2019/2020: cars.com drivetrain assignments were inferred from column alignment (flagged in notes).

In-year price changes seen: 2016 +$360 on every configuration (launch release vs cars.com); 2025 +$400 on TRD PreRunner/TRD Sport/TRD Off-Road/Limited (KBB launch vs cars.com); 2026 +$400 on every grade (Carscoops launch vs cars.com). For those years msrp is the launch price and the later figure is in the note. 2024 shows no change (cars.com = Motor1 launch).
cars.com 'Starting MSRP' is the latest MSRP for the model year, not launch pricing; for 2017-2021 and 2023 no launch source was readable, so those figures may include in-year increases.

2024-2026 TRD PreRunner (XtraCab 4x2 only) is noted on the SR5 row rather than given its own row to stay within ~8 rows; i-FORCE MAX hybrid prices for TRD Sport / TRD Off-Road / Limited are in notes. 4x4 Double Cab 'cheapest' rows for TRD Sport / TRD Off-Road are usually the 6-speed manual; automatic 4x4 prices are in notes where a source listed them.

2016 cab/bed: Toyota's table marks long beds 'LB'; unmarked Double Cab rows are assumed short bed (the release gives no other bed marker). Three 2016 model codes (7545, 7560, 7568) omit engine or drivetrain in the PDF text.
